content: Standard optimistic-concurrency pattern with SQLx: UPDATE vault_items SET ... , revision = revision + 1, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND revision = ? then check query_result.rows_affected(). If 0, either the row does not exist or the revision did not match (concurrent write) -> map to HTTP 409. SQLite has no native row-version type; the app-managed integer revision column is the correct approach.
